title: fix(i18n): Metadata Commit labels in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES; full-width punctuation in the zh-CN auth settings
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBEhb7GyXimxk27jjWsqzcbE)_

Fixes #32218

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：「元数据提交」对象（`sys_metadata_commit`）的名称和字段标签补进翻译，中文、日文、西班牙文都有了；认证设置页的中文说明把夹在中文句子里的半角 `, ; : ( )` 改成全角（35 条）。
- 为什么改：中文控制台里这两处还是英文或半角标点，看起来像没做完。审批通知标题（卡片第 1 项）挪到 #32240，因为要改的是 service-messaging 的收件箱对象，不在本卡范围；第 2 项（Home 动态英文）实测在当前 main 上已经不成立，见下文。
- 风险与回滚：只动翻译文本和翻译提取清单，不动任何运行逻辑、字段或权限。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/zh-CN.ts`（`auth` 段的标点），`packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts`（新增一行），`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts` 里的 `sys_metadata_commit` 段。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/translations/settings-translation-coverage.test.ts -t "full-width"`，预期 2 例通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`sys_metadata_commit` labels** (`packages/platform-objects`): `scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` now extracts `SysMetadataCommitObject` beside `sys_metadata`, `sys_metadata_history` and `sys_metadata_audit`. It is imported from `@objectstack/metadata-core` directly, because the back-compat barrel `src/metadata/index.ts` never re-exported it (no public export moves). The bundles were regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`. The extractor fills a new key with the English source in every locale; zh-CN (元数据提交), ja-JP (メタデータコミット) and es-ES (Confirmación de metadatos) were then translated by hand, with the field vocabulary of the sibling objects (操作者, 実行主体, Actor…). The other seven locales keep the extractor's English fill, and their source-hash companions record it as an echo, so `check:i18n-stale-fill` sees them as untranslated.
- **zh-CN auth settings punctuation** (`packages/services/service-settings`): in the `settings.auth` namespace, 35 strings had ASCII `,` `;` `:` `(` `)` inside Chinese sentences (「认证限流:最大请求数」, 「密码有效期(天)」, 「身份验证器应用(TOTP)」). They are now `，；：（）`. ASCII stays where it is part of a code, address or English name (`203.0.113.0/24`, `acme.com`, `ISO 8601`, `Auth Token`). No other namespace and no other locale was touched.

## Card items not in this PR

- **Item 1, approval notification titles → #32240.** plugin-approvals already emits `keyedText`; service-messaging renders it per recipient at delivery and the inbox channel stores only the rendered `title` / `body_md` on `sys_inbox_message`, which has no field that keeps the keys. Read-time composition therefore needs a stored-keys field and a read middleware on that object, both in service-messaging, outside this card's file surface. The seat moved it to #32240.
- **Item 2, codeless Home activity rows: premise does not hold on `origin/main`.** Measured on a fresh showcase boot (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, head b6fc8908) read through `GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity` with `Accept-Language: zh-CN`: all 34 rows after the seed load serve Chinese summaries (23 seeded `created` rows with no actor, e.g. 「创建了 数据迁移 "pinyin-search-companion"」; 10 seeded `updated` rows; the admin's sign-in stamp), and a record the admin creates reads 「创建了 分类 "QA probe 32218"」 in zh-CN and `Created Category "QA probe 32218"` in en. The CRUD mirror (`audit-writers.ts`) is the only `sys_activity` writer in this repository, and since c4968860 (2026-10-26) it stores a summary code on every branch except a fired milestone, whose author-written sentence stays untranslated by ruling. So the English rows in the report are rows written before that commit into a persisted database. No writer change was made. A backfill is not cheap: `created` / `deleted` rows could be coded from their own columns, but an older `updated` row's code needs its stored diff re-read against today's field definitions, and older milestone rows are not marked as such, so the two cannot be told apart reliably. None was built.

## Tests

- `platform-objects` `bundle-ownership.test.ts`: `sys_metadata_commit` joins the ownership list (so "every owned object is present in the bundle" covers it), plus a new top-level describe asserting the zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES label, plural and field labels are their own words, not the English source.
- `service-settings` `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`: a new top-level describe. One case proves the rule can fire (a colon, a paren pair, a comma inside Chinese are flagged; an IP range, a code span, a placeholder are not); one sweeps every string under zh-CN `settings.auth`.

<details><summary>Ablation (item 3) and before-leg (item 4)</summary>

Item 3, the extract entry replaced with a marker via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold` (on-disk count of the marker: 1), bundles regenerated (zh-CN occurrences of `sys_metadata_commit`: 0), then `vitest run src/apps/translations/bundle-ownership.test.ts`: 4 failed, 1 passed.

```
AssertionError: objects the extract config should emit are missing from the bundle: sys_metadata_commit — was an import dropped from scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts?: expected [ 'sys_metadata_commit' ] to deeply equal []
AssertionError: expected undefined to be '元数据提交' // Object.is equality
```

Restored: `ablation-replace --restore` reported blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty; the generated bundles were restored with `git checkout HEAD --`.

Item 4, `zh-CN.ts` taken from `origin/main` (`git restore --source=origin/main`), the sweep case fails and names 35 strings, the same 35 this PR changes:

```
AssertionError: half-width punctuation in zh-CN Chinese copy:
settings.auth.groups.anti_abuse.description @ 6:: 15:,
settings.auth.groups.multi_factor.description @ 13:( 18:)
settings.auth.groups.api_keys.description @ 45:,
```

Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Verification

All readings on head `b23bbfba` (branch merged with `origin/main` 0eca80a7 through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`, then a full `turbo run build --concurrency=2`, 120/120).

- `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs` (every package): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 120 files, 1937 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test`: 75 files, 1461 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings typecheck`: exit 0.
- `npx eslint` on the four hand-written files (the extract config, `zh-CN.ts`, the two test files): exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 66 derived families, each run with its exit code recorded; all 66 exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 (its fixture commit was not in the shallow clone); after `git fetch origin 621a4876` it passed (48 cases). `--ran`: 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Dogfood: not run (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm).
- Live: item 2 reading above, fresh showcase boot on a random port, torn down after (health answers 000).
